AI middleware is the new edge: LiteLLM and Langflow RCEs are exploited in the wild. 9 detections, 26 IOCs. Full analysis + IOCs: https:// in

via Mastodon https://intel.threadlinqs.com/threat/TL-2026-2818

CVE-2026-59822.evidence: CISA KEV added BerriAI LiteLLM CVE-2026-59822 (improper authentication in MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint, unauthenticated attacker) on 2026-09-02.

CVE-2026-9198.evidence: CISA KEV added Langflow CVE-2026-9198 (code injection allowing unauthenticated full RCE on default deployments) on 2026-08-04.

provenance.evidence: CISA KEV (released 2026-09-29) lists BerriAI LiteLLM CVE-2026-59822 (added 2026-09-02, unauthenticated MCP endpoint flaw) and Langflow CVE-2026-9198 (added 2026-08-04, unauthenticated full RCE) as known exploited.
